real_data_sources: JEDEC TO-264 / TO-247 through-hole package: 40mm×28mm footprint, 4x M3 mounting holes
Thermal design: 10-15 fins, 2mm thickness, 3mm spacing — standard aluminum extrusion geometry
IPC-7093: Thermal interface material (TIM) requirements for power semiconductor packages
ASHRAE 2017 Handbook: Natural convection fin spacing optimization (3-5mm for vertical fins)
verification_strategy: Parse FCStd for PartDesign::LinearPattern (key criterion for fin array), Spreadsheet::Sheet with >=4 aliases (parametric fin dimensions), PartDesign::Hole/Pocket (>=2 mounting holes), STL+STEP export sizes
anti_gaming_measures: LinearPattern is the single key criterion (25 pts) — direct fin-by-fin creation only gets 8 pts via Pad count proxy
>=4 aliases required (fin_count, fin_thickness, fin_height, base_height minimum)
Part::Array accepted as partial alternative (12 pts) but not full credit
Both STL and STEP required — proves export competence
